name: Winter sports group meetup and routing app

mentions.name: Winter sports group meetup and routing app
mentions.description: This app helps winter sports groups coordinate on the slopes. Users download a map for a ski resort, see where individuals in their group are on the map, get suggested meetup points (summits), and each person receives a personalized route generated to that point.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building an app for winter sports. You can download the map for a ski resort, and use the map to see where individuals in your group are, and suggest meetups (summits) on the map, and everyone gets a personalized route generated to that point.
